title: BLS International Services net profit rises 8% to ₹201.7 crore in Q2FY27
description:
BLS International Services Limited on Tuesday reported an 8.6 per cent year-on-year growth in consolidated profit after tax at Rs 201.7 crore during the quarter ended September 2026.
The company's PAT (profit after tax) stood at Rs 185.7 crore during the corresponding quarter of last year, BLS International Services said in a regulatory filing.
Revenue from operations grew 32 per cent to Rs 972.7 crore during the quarter under review compared to Rs 736.6 crore in the same period last year.
"The company is advancing its AI-led technology ecosystem and future-ready workforce through investments in automation, secure infrastructure, strategic partnerships and employee upskilling.
"Looking ahead, we remain confident in our growth prospects, supported by our expanding global footprint, established government relationships, technology capabilities and the growing scale of digital services.
